scope: Diagnose coupled separation/proximity conflicts on the first recovered 165x159 carrier placement. No candidate promotion or waiver.

retained_change.diagnostics: When report_infeasible_cycle is enabled, expand each failing separation origin into its named fixed/moving seed rectangles and exact separation gap. Fixed endpoints collapsed to #0 in the difference graph no longer hide the actual obstructing geometry.
retained_change.behavior: Only diagnostic log construction changes. Solver branches, limits, placement acceptance, geometry and precision operations are unchanged.
retained_change.test: Independently impossible 20x20 board fully occupied by a fixed obstacle, with a 2x2 movable at [10,10,12,12]. Assert rejection in quiet and verbose modes; exact named fixed/movable rectangles present only in verbose logs; identical poses and quantization counts.

observed_original_conflict.meaning: Horizontal separation is flipped to put HDMI below USB-JTAG, contradicting the near-SoM bound. This proves this selected separation system is infeasible, not that the board or all possible arrangements are infeasible.

bounded_experiments_removed.strategy: After existing composer strategies fail, try opposite-to-seed perpendicular ordering of all flipped separations, retaining final physical and hard-term checks.
bounded_experiments_removed.result: Fails: a Y repair adds a separation on the already-solved X axis; final edge consistency rejects it.

bounded_experiments_removed.strategy: Same opposite-order retry with at most two additional alternating X/Y consistency sweeps.
bounded_experiments_removed.result: Fails: HDMI X must be <=47.845 from the connector escape reservation and >=113.3 from the mechanical exclusion.

bounded_experiments_removed.strategy: Reverse only the first separation pair identified by the original failed repair, retaining the two bounded cross-axis rechecks and all final gates.
bounded_experiments_removed.result: Fails: HDMI X must be <=78.1 from the perpendicular near-SoM constraint and >=113.3 from the mechanical exclusion.

experiment_controls: Prepared input, same explicit 166x159 policy with 165x159 override and carrier shape/face settings as the preceding continuation experiments. Poses=8 and frontier=4096; continuations disabled to isolate repair of the first recovery choice. Each failed screen records two completed outer attempts and a captured failure receipt. Prototype retry and coupled-sweep events were explicitly logged; they were not added to production fallback metadata or independently qualified. Timings are failed construction diagnostics, not performance gains.
restoration: All temporary alternate-repair branches and members removed. Production CLI and profiler rebuilt; only failure-diagnostic logging and its tests remain changed.

restored_candidate_check.qualification: Construction-only; still not an accepted smaller board.

next_direction: Do not repeat these three strategies on this seed. Multiple coupled separation choices need reconsideration together, or earlier placement needs to reserve a constraint-compatible slot. Single greedy flip-direction changes do not establish a globally usable layout. Preserve the 166x159 qualified reference; the earlier 165x159 continuation candidate remains experimental and exceeds fallback ceilings. No routing or fabrication-readiness claim.
